instructions:
ClickO

1. Click the blue goal, it will change to purple if mouse cursor is on target.
2. if mis-clicked the background or didn't click the target before it shrinks to the smallest, you will lose a life. If all three lives are gone, the next miss will end the game.
3. difficulties are available in options, choose the one that fits you.
4. each score will restore 1 life until all 3 lives are restored.
5. have fun.
